Direct /etc edits as part of container service lifecycle

custom_os_builds.mechanism: bootc Containerfile builds via Forgejo CI

pod_files.rationale: Pods add orchestration complexity that Quadlet per-container network and dependency model handles more cleanly at single-operator homelab scale.

critical_distinction.rootless_podman: User unit via systemctl --user. Quadlet in ~/.config/containers/systemd/. Podman runs under operator UID with subuid/subgid namespace mapping.
critical_distinction.rootful_with_privilege_drop: System unit in /etc/containers/systemd/ with User= in [Service]. Podman runs as root, forks, drops privileges. This is NOT rootless Podman. These are fundamentally different isolation models and must not be conflated.

runtime_constraints.linger: loginctl enable-linger <user> — required for user units to survive without a login session

selinux.enforcement: enforcing — never disabled, never permissive in production

hierarchy.use_case: Persistent data directories dedicated to a container or service. Applied once at provisioning time, not at container start.

Non-standard access patterns requiring a custom policy module: sockets (e.g. Podman socket passthrough to runner), restricted host paths, cross-context access. Flow: podman inspect → udica → sudo semodule -i → SecurityLabelType= in Quadlet.
hierarchy.note: semodule requires root — generate and load policy at provisioning time, not at container start.

hierarchy.use_case: Diagnostic only. Read denials, understand them, write a proper policy. Never pipe audit2allow output directly to semodule in production.

volume_flags.z_Z_in_committed_quadlets: discouraged — quadctl audit might get a feature to warn on z/Z presence in committed intent files
volume_flags.z_Z_during_development: permitted with awareness — useful shortcut during exploration
volume_flags.rationale: z/Z are chcon shortcuts reverted by restorecon. They mask labeling errors and are not a policy. The better path is tier 1 or tier 2.
volume_flags.pragmatic_position: Operator is sole decision-maker. Use z/Z when the situation warrants. The constraint exists to remind of the better path and to surface it in audit output, not to block.

selinux.state_directory_note: StateDirectory= in user units resolves to ~/.local/state/<n> which carries user_home_t — does NOT inherit container_file_t. semanage fcontext must be applied explicitly if that path is volume-mounted into a container. StateDirectory= is appropriate for runtime state the container does not mount (pid files, runner registration files, etc.).

hierarchy.use_case: TPM2-bound at-rest encryption. Preferred for all secrets where the application supports file-based injection.
hierarchy.quadlet_bridge: Volume=%d:/run/secrets:ro — maps CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY into container as read-only tmpfs
hierarchy.caveat: [Speculation] %d specifier expansion inside Quadlet [Container] Volume= requires verification. Quadlet generator may or may not expand it. Test before production use.

hierarchy.use_case: Podman-managed secret store, file-based injection. No TPM2 binding. Use when systemd-creds bridge is unverified or the application reads from a file path.
When the application has no _FILE convention and cannot read from a path (e.g. Forgejo's FORGEJO__section__KEY pattern). Acknowledge trade-off: secret visible in /proc/<pid>/environ.
hierarchy.migration_path: Build a shim layer FROM upstream image that reads /run/secrets/* and exports env vars — moves secret to tier 2. Deferred until hardening pipeline is established.
hierarchy.pragmatic_position: Use type=env when the file-based workaround is more trouble than the security trade-off is worth at current threat model. The constraint exists as a reminder of the better path, not a hard block.

hierarchy.use_case: PROHIBITED for sensitive values. Unencrypted plaintext on disk. Permitted only for non-sensitive configuration: feature flags, tuning parameters.

env_in_quadlet.non_sensitive: Environment= directives in [Container] — declarative, git-trackable, correct
env_in_quadlet.sensitive: Never in Environment= in committed files. Use secret hierarchy above.

volume_management.philosophy: Prefer .volume Quadlet files over inline Volume= for persistent data. Direct Volume= bind mounts are correct for config files that must exist at unit evaluation time.

mode_a_podman_managed.description: Podman-managed named volume. Opaque storage path under Podman's storage root (~/.local/share/containers/storage/volumes/).
mode_a_podman_managed.selinux: Auto-labeled container_file_t by Podman. No semanage required.
mode_a_podman_managed.backup: Target Podman volume storage path in Restic/Garage backup config.
mode_a_podman_managed.use_case: Opaque runtime data: database files, LFS blobs, Garage object storage

mode_b_bind_wrapped.description: Named .volume file wrapping a bind mount to an explicit host path via Options=bind,src=<path>.
mode_b_bind_wrapped.selinux: semanage fcontext required on host path before first start.
mode_b_bind_wrapped.use_case: Data where explicit host path matters for backup targeting or external tooling

direct_bind_in_container.description: Inline Volume= in .container file pointing to host path.
direct_bind_in_container.use_case: Config files that must exist before container starts; paths tracked in git and managed centrally
direct_bind_in_container.selinux: semanage fcontext required on host path

image_management.philosophy: Use .image Quadlet files for all images in non-trivial deployments. Inline Image= without a corresponding .image file is acceptable during ad-hoc development only.
source_hierarchy: docker.io — last resort; prefer verified publisher images

auto_update.upstream_images: AutoUpdate=registry — monitors digest changes on upstream tag
auto_update.local_registry_images: AutoUpdate=registry — meaningful once image is pushed to forge.handahl.org
auto_update.local_pre_registry: PodmanArgs=--pull=never — for locally built images not yet in a registry
auto_update.contradiction: --pull=never and AutoUpdate=registry must not be combined

manifest.description: Single source of truth for all image references, update policies, and build sources
manifest.quadctl_command: quadctl image sync — generates .image files from manifest
manifest.status: planned — not yet implemented in quadctl

network_constraints.philosophy: Explicit network attachment only. No container on default bridge unless intentional and documented.

defined_networks.hanlab-backend.network: Internal service-to-service communication. No external exposure.
defined_networks.runner-isolated.network: Forgejo runner. Must have no route to hanlab-backend.network — blast radius containment.

network_constraints.runner_network_isolation: Runner container may not reach hanlab-backend.network. Jobs run as sibling containers on runner-isolated.network only.

apply_to_all_containers.AddCapability: only what upstream OCI inspect + documentation explicitly requires — not guesswork

hardening_defaults.capability_source_of_truth: podman image inspect Config.Capabilities + upstream documentation
hardening_defaults.seccomp: Default Podman seccomp profile unless upstream documents specific syscall requirements

Host directory creation beyond ExecStartPre mkdir for runtime dirs

philosophical_positions.living_organism: The homelab changes frequently. Constraints exist to guide decisions and enable automated linting, not to create friction. Operator is sole decision-maker and final authority.
philosophical_positions.immutability: Prefer immutable base + layered configuration over mutable runtime state
philosophical_positions.secret_hygiene: Secrets never touch disk unencrypted, never in git, never in Environment= if avoidable. Pragmatic exceptions acknowledged and documented.
philosophical_positions.selinux_posture: SELinux is a first-class constraint. z/Z and audit2allow are development tools; tier 1/2 are the production target.
philosophical_positions.ad_hoc_vs_overcommit: Start ad-hoc to learn the trade. Commit to architecture after understanding failure modes.
philosophical_positions.single_operator: One human. This constrains tooling complexity, not security boundaries. Service-account isolation remains a valid goal, deferred pending Kanidm.
philosophical_positions.quadctl_philosophy: quadctl manages intent. systemd executes intent. Podman runs workloads. These layers must not be conflated.
philosophical_positions.audit_posture: Constraints inform quadctl audit warnings. Warnings inform the operator. The operator decides.
